name: ContextForge (IBM MCP Context Forge)
summary: IBM's open-source registry and proxy that federates MCP, A2A and REST/gRPC APIs into one endpoint with centralized governance, discovery, guardrails and observability.
description: Runs as a fully compliant MCP server, deployable via PyPI (`mcp-contextforge-gateway`, Python >=3.12,<3.14) or Docker, and scales to multi-cluster Kubernetes with Redis-backed federation and caching. Supports plugins. Latest release v1.1.0 (2026-10-20).
